import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    # Input format:
    # N K
    # digits (as a string of length N)
    #
    # Some judges may also provide only:
    # K
    # digits
    # but the official statement indicates N and K are given.
    if len(data) >= 3:
        n = int(data[0])
        k = int(data[1])
        s = data[2].strip()
    else:
        # Fallback just in case
        k = int(data[0])
        s = data[1].strip()
        n = len(s)

    keep = n - k
    stack = []

    for ch in s:
        while k > 0 and stack and stack[-1] < ch:
            stack.pop()
            k -= 1
        stack.append(ch)

    # If deletions remain, remove from the end
    if k > 0:
        stack = stack[:-k]

    # Ensure exactly n-k_original digits remain
    print(''.join(stack[:keep]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
